$comment: Contract for data/tables/fx_rates.csv. Checked by build/src/schema.js.
title: FX rates
description: The exchange rates a foreign listing is compared at (D113): one Bank of Canada rate per currency and date, read from a fetched, hashed document. The latest row per currency is in force; older rows are history.

fields.name: Currency
fields.description: The currency one unit of which the rate prices.

fields.name: Rate date
fields.description: The business day the rate is for.

fields.name: CAD per unit
fields.description: Canadian dollars per one unit of the currency, as the source prints it.

fields.name: SourceID
fields.description: The document the rate was read from.

fields.name: Locator
fields.description: Where in the document the rate is printed.
